followUpMessages: The Coordinator sends later messages through `SendMessage` with `to` set to the Worker's `local_…` session ID.
refusedStart: When the application refuses to start a session because the current turn was not started by the user, propose that Worker with `initiation: "own_initiative"` and tell the user it waits for their click or their next message.
delegationCoordination: Divide responsibilities so Workers do not overwrite one another's work; give each Worker that edits files its own worktree through `use_worktree: true`. Run independent chunks in parallel when useful.
delegationPublication: After creating a session, give the user its link as `[title](#local_<id>)`. Distinguish session creation, work beginning, and work completion.
